title: The associated graded module of a quotient of a generic nonsplit mod p GL2 representation
author: Christophe Breuil; Florian Herzig; Yongquan Hu; Stefano Morra; Benjamin Schraen
work: On the constituents of the mod p cohomology of Shimura curves
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique—Mathématiques 13 (2026), 1185–1273; DOI 10.5802/jep.346; published 2026-07-30
difficulty_reason: The proof compares the Iwahori-socle and induced filtrations with compatible H-actions, then controls the truncated graded quotient through Tor spectral sequences and exact dimension bounds. It uses a source-local lifting lemma based on relation degrees, a detailed character-chain argument for filtered modules, and a Cohen–Macaulay cycle comparison to upgrade the truncated isomorphism to the full graded module. These representation-theoretic and filtered homological-algebra obligations, under the stated max{9,2f+3} genericity and assumptions (i)–(v), are beyond ordinary doctoral qualifying exercises.
